series_short_description: A tense, atmospheric thriller tracking a group of friends through a dangerous downpour along US Highway 11.
series_description: Pebble Borrow is a tense, atmospheric thriller that kicks off with a sudden, freezing downpour on the unforgiving asphalt of US Highway 11. As a group of friends navigates a dangerous, uncertain journey, the narrative ratchets up the suspense, exploring the limits of endurance, the bonds of loyalty, and the terrifying reality of being entirely exposed to the elements.
